# fMRITransferLearning

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method that applies transfer learning techniques to functional magnetic resonance imaging data to map shared and unique neural activity patterns across cognitive tasks. Provides a principled way to transfer learned neural dynamics into neuromorphic hardware, improving efficiency in brain-inspired computing architectures.
